[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary Part I, 30th October, 2002]
F. No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
30-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information:---
2. Insertion of new section
5A, Act VIII of 1975.---In the Federal Investigation Agency Act, 1974 (VIII
of 1975), after section 5 the following new section shall be inserted,
namely:---
"57. Certatn
Officers of the Agency deemed to be Public Prosecutors. ---Notwithstanding
anything contained to any order law for the time being in force the Assistant
Directors (Legal) and the Deputy Directors (Law) of the Agency shall be deemed
to be Public Prosecutors and shall be competent to institute and conduct any
proceedings in cases sent up for trial by the Agency to the Special Courts
constituted under any law and the Courts subordinate to the High Court."
